adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Protein-triggered hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia with suppressed ketones and persistent mild hyperammonemia identifies GLUD1-related hyperinsulinism-hyperammonemia syndrome.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: HADH-related hyperinsulinism can also be protein/leucine sensitive, making it the strongest alternative; however persistent hyperammonemia is the defining discriminator for activating GLUD1 disease. SLC16A1 is exercise-triggered, while ABCC8 and GCK do not explain the hyperammonemia-protein pattern.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The combination of persistent hyperammonemia and postprandial protein sensitivity specifically supports GLUD1 over the other hyperinsulinism genes.
